summary: On paper Kansas City has the edge (Kansas City's defense ranks 18th in EPA per dropback, +0.03 allowed), while Seattle's best counter is to win up front (Seattle's defense ranks 1st in pressure rate, 26% generated). Under center, Patrick Mahomes ranks 10th of 26 in EPA per dropback and Sam Darnold ranks 24th; x-factor: Kenneth Walker III gains +2.7 rushing yards over expected per carry, 1st of 29, and Seattle's run defense ranks 1st. The model favors Kansas City at 78%, mostly on rushing matchup (7.4 pts) and starting QB (3.2 pts).
